1 נספח
Objective
To estimate the risk of ischaemic stroke associated with
Antidopaminergic antiemetic (ADA) use.
Setting
The nationwide French healthcare database.
Participants
Participants were ≥18 years with a first ischaemic stroke
between 2012 and 2016, matched with a control group of 21 859
randomly selected people free of the event. The matching was
by age, sex, and risk factors of ischaemic stroke.
Main outcome measures
Association between ADA use and risk of ischaemic stroke was
assessed by estimating the odds ratios of exposure evaluated in
patients with stroke and in controls. Analyses were adjusted for
confounders.
